curse.jjkcraft.ash_oni.desc: Lowers its horns and charges in a straight line, sweeping all aside: dodge sideways. Into a wall, or beaten hard, it staggers. Immune to fire.
curse.jjkcraft.ash_oni.lore: Fear of the fire that took the old town, given horns. It still runs at the walls that would not let it through.
curse.jjkcraft.blackwater_bride.desc: A trailing ink spirit that punishes careless pursuit.
curse.jjkcraft.blackwater_bride.lore: Blackwater Bride is born from forgotten fears. Watch its windup, step clear of its cast, and punish its recovery. Its cursed core reveals how badly it is wounded.

curse.jjkcraft.bone_orchard.lore: Bone Orchard is born from forgotten fears. Watch its windup, step clear of its cast, and punish its recovery. Its cursed core reveals how badly it is wounded.
curse.jjkcraft.cracked_bell.desc: Swings back, then tolls a shockwave along the ground. Jump over the wave. Takes double damage while still ringing.
curse.jjkcraft.cracked_bell.lore: A temple bell that cracked on the night it rang for a fire. It has been ringing the alarm ever since.
curse.jjkcraft.culling_warden.desc: Can't die while its Rule Seals stand: break them. Its weak point follows the current Edict: steel, distance or energy.
curse.jjkcraft.culling_warden.lore: The rules of the game, given a body. It does not hate the players. It only enforces.
curse.jjkcraft.doorframe_hunter.desc: Waits invisible inside door frames and ambushes whoever comes close or opens the door. In a fight a nearby door rattles before it steps out of it. Away from doors it is exposed.
curse.jjkcraft.doorframe_hunter.lore: Every house has a doorway someone was afraid to walk past at night. This is what stood in it.
curse.jjkcraft.echo_mimic.desc: Copies your last five actions, techniques, swings and jumps, and plays each one back at you three seconds later.
curse.jjkcraft.echo_mimic.lore: It has no voice of its own. It wears what it saw you do, a few seconds late, like a borrowed coat.
curse.jjkcraft.gilded_mimic.desc: Looks like a chest. Get close, or stare at it, and it springs: its tongue grabs and drags you. Hit it hard to break free.
curse.jjkcraft.gilded_mimic.lore: Greed for what someone else left behind, given a lid and a tongue. It has never once been opened willingly.
curse.jjkcraft.gravebound_gate.desc: A rooted gate that walls the clearing and calls lesser curses; kill them to break its guard. Its phases change the arena: the wall closes in, then graves open.
curse.jjkcraft.gravebound_gate.lore: Every graveyard has a gate, and every gate knows the way back. This one has forgotten which side it is meant to keep closed.

curse.jjkcraft.grief_cathedral.lore: Grief Cathedral is born from forgotten fears. Watch its windup, step clear of its cast, and punish its recovery. Its cursed core reveals how badly it is wounded.

curse.jjkcraft.hollow_hymnal.lore: Born from the dread of a hymn sung at too many funerals. It still remembers the tune, and nothing else.

curse.jjkcraft.pale_stilt.lore: Every child who ever jumped across a gap felt it reach. It never caught them on the ground.
curse.jjkcraft.paper_tide_gravemind.desc: Adapts: after a few hits of one kind of damage it resists that kind, then all but ignores it. Keep changing how you hurt it.
curse.jjkcraft.paper_tide_gravemind.lore: Ten thousand grave charms, each written for someone else's dead. Together they remember every way the living have tried to end them.

curse.jjkcraft.redacted_saint.lore: A face blacked out of every record, every photograph, every prayer. It has been wearing other people's ever since.

curse.jjkcraft.salt_lantern.desc: Fires a beam of bitter light that burns cursed energy: the more CE you carry, the worse it burns. Block it with a shield or a wall; step aside when the aim locks.
curse.jjkcraft.salt_lantern.lore: Salt for the threshold, a lamp for the lost. Something kept both, long after the house had no one left to protect.

curse.jjkcraft.ten_mouth_sovereign.desc: Final boss with ten mouths: it speaks commands, then bites from the ground, then opens its own domain. Bring a Simple Domain.
curse.jjkcraft.ten_mouth_sovereign.lore: Every word anyone wished they had not said, swallowed and spoken back. It has a mouth for each of the ten worst.
curse.jjkcraft.thorn_matriarch.desc: Roots erupt where she marks the ground and hedge off your retreat. She grows stronger as the day goes on; fight her at dawn or at night.
curse.jjkcraft.thorn_matriarch.lore: The overgrown garden behind the house nobody visits. She tends it from dawn to dusk, and she does not like guests.
curse.jjkcraft.tidewash.desc: Born in water. Floods the ground around its prey and grabs with long arms that drag you under. Strong when wet, weak on dry ground.
curse.jjkcraft.tidewash.lore: Every river has a place where swimmers are warned not to go. This is what lives in that warning.
curse.jjkcraft.tithe_burrower.desc: Steals from your inventory and burrows away. It wants one item (shown over its head): drop it nearby and it returns everything and leaves.
curse.jjkcraft.tithe_burrower.lore: The dread of debts that are always called in. It keeps a careful account, and it always offers terms.
curse.jjkcraft.unfinished_ferryman.desc: Arena boss. On a timer the crossing opens and a current drags everyone to its shore, where you are ferried: walk against the flow.
curse.jjkcraft.unfinished_ferryman.lore: It takes travellers the rest of the way: the ones whose roads ended before they did.

curse.jjkcraft.veil_weaver.lore: Veil Weaver is born from forgotten fears. Watch its windup, step clear of its cast, and punish its recovery. Its cursed core reveals how badly it is wounded.
curse.jjkcraft.vow_kin.desc: Fights only those who hold a Binding Vow, harder the heavier the vow. Break or renounce your vow and it flees.
curse.jjkcraft.vow_kin.lore: Born from promises people did not keep. It cannot stand to see one kept, and cannot stand to watch one broken.
curse.jjkcraft.wick_moth.desc: Swarms in the dark and eats light: candles go out, torches fall. Faster and fiercer where it is dark. Weak to fire.
curse.jjkcraft.wick_moth.lore: A child's fear of the moment the candle goes out, multiplied by every child who ever lay awake.

dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.a_bright_future: Yuka's headaches are gone. Completely gone.
Itadori came by and left something with the school. He asked that it go to someone who will keep it safe.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.berserk.cross_1: I am Cross, his brother. Our technique is shared; when he uses it without thinking, I feel it.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.berserk.cross_2: Some of us would have welcomed a reason for war today. Don't give them one.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.berserk.intro_1: Water lifts out of a cup and hangs in the air. Across town, an unconscious Maru opens his third eye.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.berserk.intro_2: His technique, Chaos, bends the laws of order: gravity, heat, the path of a thrown stone.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.berserk.maru_1: Maru turns his third eye on you. Your thoughts slide sideways.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.berserk.maru_2: You remind him what he said to the boy: that you would be neighbors.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.berserk.usami_1: So the inspector is an alien. The secrecy is over, then.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.berserk.usami_2: One of their envoys could conquer Japan alone. His name is Dabura Karaba. Remember it.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.chaos_and_harmo: A future where I won didn't feel right. I can't explain it better than that.
Take Honoyagi for now. Its own energy pays for its cuts, so even I can draw it.
Chaos and Harmony. Both of them, then.
I asked Maru to take his people away so Yuka wouldn't have to die fighting. He said no. So we fight.
Gravity tips over. Rika rises behind Tsurugi. At the last moment he lets go of his katana and is cut down.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.cultural_exchan: Not bad. Maru came up with a bigger one, covered in stings. He refuses a rash guard.
The Simurians want to make takoyaki themselves. We need wancha octopus: one tentacle, all eight flavors. Watch the jellyfish.
I'm the nutritionist and I'm not cooking the main course? Fine. What on earth is this octopus?
Take some with you. There is far too much.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.forbidden_techn: Yuka forms the seal of the Ten Shadows and calls the shikigami no one in her line has ever tamed: Mahoraga.
Ten Shadows' strongest shikigami. Every time something hurts it, its wheel turns, and it adapts.
It adapted to his Light. He can't touch it now.
I'm fine. I'm fine. Go and find my brother.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.inhuman_makyo.c: This is Mul, the ore our conflict was fought over. It turns rolloluca into any kind of energy.
Rolloluca is their word for cursed energy. This ship runs on cursed energy. If that gets out, people will be hunted for it again.
Try it yourself: pour your cursed energy into a piece of Mul.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.inhuman_makyo.d: I fight for the Rumel tribe. On Simuria, a dispute is settled by one champion against another.
Bring your champion to the ruins of your old capital.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.inhuman_makyo.i: In Tokyo, a Simurian weeps from his third eye: sorcerers are exorcising cursed spirits, and to Rumelians they look like Kalyans, the sacred beasts.
In the confusion, Cross is shot.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.inhuman_makyo.u: The Rumelians demand Tokyo, as a nation where cursed spirits are protected. We cannot stop exorcising them; they would spill out of Tokyo.
They have challenged us to a duel, the Deskunte way. Japan has chosen its champion: Yuka Okkotsu.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.kyoto_abduction: He moves through his talismans. Burn them, or watch your back.
At the end of the road, hands reach out of the dark: a barrier technique built to carry people away.
This road is under a gaze-manipulation curse. It nudges whoever walks it down one path.
Walk it in the order it wants, and we'll see where it leads.
The children are alive. Good work.
He says he was quitting the trade, because the aliens will soon show the world how weak our sorcerers have become. Keep that to yourself.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.ritual_of_harmo: Light, and its reversal. Let us see which of us is the warrior.
When the black mass grows in his hands, get something solid between you and him.
Dabura understands Reverse Cursed Technique by watching it, builds a barrier by watching one, and pours positive energy into his Light.
My Harmony took Dabura home. He has a sister to free and a friend to bury.
I meant to make a world where cursed spirits are never born. Itadori said it cannot be done by taking cursed energy from Japan alone.
Rumelians, Kalyans and cursed spirits share one color of soul. That is why we mistook them. I will scatter it.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.special_grade_i: 2086, sixty-eight years after the Culling Game. A mothership carrying nearly fifty thousand Simurians hangs high above Nevada.
The United States has left all dealings with them to Japan. The Jujutsu Inspector General calls it a special grade incident.
You must be one of Japan's sorcerers. I'm Marulu Val Vol Yelvori. Maru is fine.
My people want to know whether we can live beside you. I'm to go with your sorcerers and see for myself.
The inspector will neither help nor hinder your work. Those are his orders.
Take the gate down to Kyoto. I'll follow.
Children are vanishing in Kyoto. Japanese citizens are taken and sold, because their cursed energy can be burned for power.
Yuka and Tsurugi Okkotsu will look into it. The Simurian inspector goes with you; he is here under the Security Treaty.
It is an investigation, not a fight. Try to remember that.
An inspector? Fine. Just don't slow us down.
Ignore my brother. Maru, you're with us. Let's find those kids.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.swimming_throug: Raise this one well. Don't let it become another Toranosuke.
Villagers in the mountains of Gifu keep being attacked. Something big came down the river valley.
I was a sorcerer once. The killer isn't a curse. It's a tiger. Toranosuke.
They restored the solar plant on the mountain, and the heat dried his river. He came down for water and found people.
I wanted to save him. Keep him far from town.
A beast that has eaten people has to be put down.
dialogue.jjkcraft.modulo.the_boy_who_kep: I found my mother dead three years ago. I begged her to let me stay in first grade forever.
Something has looked after me ever since. It never hurts me.
Then let us be your neighbors. Someone who understands why your feelings matter.
Tsurugi, listen: there are five bodies buried at Masaki Takeda's house. The real Masaki Takeda is an old man.
Marmalade Boy: he sews with human skin. Himself, his guardian, anything.
If he hides inside that guardian, tear him out of it.
Every year the same boy enrols at Shuei Elementary under a new name. Masayoshi, then Masaaki, now Masaki. His face never changes.
Each year he moves away with his family before second grade. Each year he comes back.

epilogue.jjkcraft.modulo.1: The Ritual of Harmony ends. Across Tokyo, cursed spirits come apart into motes of light and rise.
epilogue.jjkcraft.modulo.2: Yuka wakes as Mahoraga's wheel falls and melts into shadow. The pain in her head is gone.
epilogue.jjkcraft.modulo.3: On Simuria, Dabura and Spejo walk into the chieftain's hall. The Deskunte kneel to a new chief, and Dura is buried as a hero.
epilogue.jjkcraft.modulo.4: Aboard the Naunax, the Rumelians vote to keep living beside the Kalyans: they are family.
epilogue.jjkcraft.modulo.5: No new sorcerers will be born. Yuji Itadori decides that when he dies, he will become a cursed object, so the energy can be taken back if it is ever needed.
epilogue.jjkcraft.modulo.6: In Kyoto, sorcerers and Simurians play catch.

Reaches two blocks further than a sword. While held, it lends Grave Chains.
item.jjkcraft.debt_cleaver.desc: Each hit takes 6 CE from the target and pays it to you. While held, it lends Cleave.
item.jjkcraft.drifting_gourd.desc: Uncork it to ride its cloud: you can fly while you hold it, for 3 CE a second. Cork it, or run dry, and the cloud lets you down gently.
item.jjkcraft.gravity_harness.desc: Simurian work. Switched on, gravity loosens its hold: you fall slowly and jump high.
item.jjkcraft.honoyagi.desc: Tsurugi Okkotsu's katana. Sparks between scabbard and guard set its blade alight. A medium: it pays for its technique with its own durability.
item.jjkcraft.inverted_spear_of_heaven.d: Its strikes force cursed techniques to cancel: a hit ends the target's active technique and drains 15 CE.
item.jjkcraft.mul_ward.desc: Held, it takes half of each blow and pays for it in Mul energy.
item.jjkcraft.naunax_beacon.desc: Calls you to the Naunax's arrival hall once you have boarded it; used aboard, it sends you back where you boarded.
item.jjkcraft.rumelian_blade.desc: A forked Rumelian sword with Mul set in its hilt. Lends Mul Lance, paid in Mul energy.
item.jjkcraft.split_soul_katana.desc: A long blade that remembers every cut. While held, it lends Dismantle at a quarter off.
item.jjkcraft.takoyaki.desc: From the cultural exchange at Kyoto Jujutsu High. Very hot.
item.jjkcraft.tally_ledger.desc: Holds Culling Game points: use to enter 5, sneak and use to take them all out. Only works while a rule lets points change hands.
item.jjkcraft.tiger_cub.desc: Toranosuke's cub. Osada promised to raise it well.
item.jjkcraft.wancha_octopus.desc: A mutated octopus with one tentacle that is said to hold the flavor of all eight.
item.jjkcraft.withered_digit.desc: A cursed object. Swallowing it grants a technique you lack, and unsettles your cursed energy for a minute. Below its grade, it fights back.
item.jjkcraft.yuji_cursed_object.desc: Yuji Itadori resolved that after his death he would become a cursed object, so the energy could be taken back if it is ever needed again.

message.jjkcraft.modulo.no_sleep: There is nowhere to sleep here.

technique.jjkcraft.antigravity_system.de: Lift nearby enemies and slow their fall. A close-range body-transfer family extension.
technique.jjkcraft.batto_sword_drawing: New Shadow Style: Batto Sword Drawing
technique.jjkcraft.batto_sword_drawing.d: The fastest draw of the New Shadow Style. With Honoyagi the blade leaves its scabbard in sparks and the cut sweeps out as fire.
technique.jjkcraft.blood_edge.desc: Harden blood into a close-range cutting edge. Sweep a narrow arc in front of you.
technique.jjkcraft.blood_needle.desc: Compress blood into a narrow crimson projectile. A precise, low-cost Blood Manipulation attack.
technique.jjkcraft.boogie_woogie.desc: Clap to exchange positions with the target you are aiming at. Both destinations need free space.
technique.jjkcraft.boogie_woogie_extende: A more distant positional exchange. Use the terrain to turn a fight.
technique.jjkcraft.brain_transplant.desc: Aim at a fallen humanoid body within six blocks. Inhabit that body and inherit up to three host moves. A living player cannot be taken over.
technique.jjkcraft.cleave.desc: Adaptive close-range slashes. Cleave scales against the target’s health, armour and cursed energy; 40% of its damage bypasses armour.
technique.jjkcraft.construction_armor.de: Build temporary armor around your body, exchanging speed for protection.
technique.jjkcraft.crimson_binding.desc: Weave your blood into a net that binds a target. Stronger Blood Manipulation unlocks with your grade.
technique.jjkcraft.cursed_roots.desc: Roots bind nearby enemies in place.
technique.jjkcraft.cursed_speech_blast_a: A cursed word that throws listeners into the air.
technique.jjkcraft.cursed_speech_crumble: A cursed word that slams listeners to the ground.
technique.jjkcraft.cursed_speech_dont_mo: A cursed word that freezes everyone in earshot. Commanding the strong strains your throat.
technique.jjkcraft.cursed_spirit_manipul: Sneak-cast to absorb a curse below 30% health; cast normally to release one. Store eight and command up to three at once.
technique.jjkcraft.disaster_flames.desc: Ignite and burn nearby enemies with volcanic cursed energy.
technique.jjkcraft.disaster_tides.desc: A rushing pressure wave pushes nearby enemies away.
technique.jjkcraft.dismantle.desc: Send a precise, long-range cutting line through enemies. Most of its damage ignores armour.
technique.jjkcraft.ember_insect.desc: A concentrated ember projectile that strikes at range.
technique.jjkcraft.ember_skin.desc: Toggle. While it burns, whoever strikes you in melee is burned back and set alight. Costs CE every second.
technique.jjkcraft.flower_field.desc: A broad field of roots that immobilizes enemies.
technique.jjkcraft.flowing_red_scale.des: Control your circulation to raise physical speed and striking power.
technique.jjkcraft.frost_calm.desc: Freeze enemies around you in a short burst of cold.
technique.jjkcraft.grave_chains.desc: Cursed chains that pin the target where it stands.
technique.jjkcraft.gravity_reversal.desc: Press enemies down with a dense gravitational field.
technique.jjkcraft.ground_toll.desc: Slams the ground: a ring of force hurts and throws up everyone around you, harder up close.
technique.jjkcraft.grudge_bolt.desc: A fast bolt of condensed cursed energy.
technique.jjkcraft.hollow_purple.desc: Hollow Technique: Purple. Blue and Red forced together into a slow imaginary mass that erases what it passes.
technique.jjkcraft.ice_lance.desc: Launch a sharp lance of cursed ice.
technique.jjkcraft.icefall.desc: A wide wave of freezing cursed energy.
Reshapes the soul, and the body follows. Look at someone to shrink them: quicker but feeble. Look at nothing to bulk yourself up: bigger and armored, but slower.
technique.jjkcraft.infinity.desc: Automatically enabled with Limitless. Toggle to disable it. Stops incoming attacks; consumes CE and suppresses regeneration until RCT is learned. Environmental damage, sure-hits and dispelling tools still apply.
technique.jjkcraft.ink_iron_palm.desc: A palm strike sheathed in cursed energy. Timed perfectly, it can become a Black Flash.
technique.jjkcraft.ink_step.desc: Slip six blocks along your facing, untouchable for a moment.
technique.jjkcraft.lacquer_ward.desc: Hold to raise a barrier in front of you. Blocked hits cost cursed energy.
technique.jjkcraft.lapse_blue.desc: Converges space toward a point, dragging enemies in. Meets Reversal: Red in a burst.
technique.jjkcraft.maximum_output_blue.d: A slow, maximum-output charge. Launch a collapsing attraction core outward; its sixteen-block influence gathers enemies before a twelve-block collapse.
technique.jjkcraft.maximum_uzumaki.desc: Consume every stored curse in a powerful linear cursed-energy attack. More captured spirits increase its damage.
technique.jjkcraft.mul_lance.desc: A Rumelian blade throws a lance of Mul energy. Paid in Mul energy, not cursed energy.
technique.jjkcraft.oathbound_edge.desc: A cut sworn on your vow: 10% harder for every point of your active Binding Vow, half as hard without one. Measured Pace sharpens it further.
technique.jjkcraft.perfect_sphere.desc: A compact armor-piercing line of crushing pressure.
technique.jjkcraft.piercing_blood.desc: Ultimate. Blood Manipulation: compresses your blood for a moment, then fires it in a long crimson line that pierces everyone in its path and most armor.
technique.jjkcraft.positive_energy_outpu: Send positive energy into an ally to heal them, or mend yourself less efficiently. Requires learned RCT.
technique.jjkcraft.projection_sorcery.de: Execute a saved movement/combat route, or a terrain-aware preset. Edit destinations and physical moves in the workshop route planner. Movement is collision-checked; breaking a frame against terrain briefly freezes you. Crouch to cancel.
technique.jjkcraft.ratio.desc: Strike the seven-to-three weak point. Accurate hits during Cursed Combat gain a Ratio opening.
technique.jjkcraft.reversal_red.desc: Diverges space away from a point, throwing enemies back. Meets Lapse: Blue in a burst.
technique.jjkcraft.reverse_cursed_techni: Hold to turn cursed energy into positive energy that heals you. Glows while it works.
technique.jjkcraft.seeking_grudge_bolt.d: A slower bolt that bends toward the nearest enemy ahead.
technique.jjkcraft.sky_manipulation.desc: Bend the air around you to repel enemies.
technique.jjkcraft.sky_step.desc: A rising step with temporary slow falling.
technique.jjkcraft.splinter_volley.desc: Throws five splinters of cursed energy in a fan.
technique.jjkcraft.star_rage.desc: Add virtual mass to your strikes: temporary Strength and Resistance without slowing your movement.
Binds the one you look at to a straw doll in your hands. Drive a nail into the doll: they are hurt wherever they stand nearby (3 nails, 30 s).
technique.jjkcraft.ten_shadows_divine_do: Summons the two Divine Dogs for 30 s. They circle whoever you fight to flank them, then lunge and bite. Casting again summons them anew.
technique.jjkcraft.ten_shadows_nue.desc: Summons Nue for 45 s. It circles above you, marks enemies hunting you so they glow through walls, and dives at your target.
technique.jjkcraft.ten_shadows_toad.desc: Summons the Toad for 30 s. It keeps to your side, draws enemies' anger onto itself and swats down projectiles aimed at you.
technique.jjkcraft.thin_ice_breaker.desc: Strike a bent surface of the sky and shatter it through the target.
technique.jjkcraft.thousand_lances.desc: Ultimate. Marks the ground where you look; lances rain on the area for three seconds.
technique.jjkcraft.volcanic_burst.desc: A violent close-range eruption of heat.
technique.jjkcraft.water_lance.desc: A high-pressure projectile of cursed water.

trait.jjkcraft.ce_abundance.desc: An unusually large innate energy reserve.
trait.jjkcraft.electric_energy.desc: Innate electrical cursed-energy texture adds a small shock to your physical hits.
trait.jjkcraft.fleet_footed.desc: Naturally faster movement without spending a technique slot.
trait.jjkcraft.fragile_conduit.desc: A frail body trades health and mobility for a much larger cursed-energy reserve.
trait.jjkcraft.heavenly_body.desc: Zero cursed energy in exchange for enhanced strength, speed and senses.
trait.jjkcraft.iron_constitution.desc: A naturally resilient body with additional maximum health.
trait.jjkcraft.iron_frame.desc: Zero CE. A dense body gains health and armor at the cost of speed.
trait.jjkcraft.powerful_frame.desc: Stronger physical strikes and a slightly heavier body.
trait.jjkcraft.rough_energy.desc: A coarse cursed-energy texture makes physical impacts harsher.
trait.jjkcraft.silent_stride.desc: Zero CE. A light, fast body sacrifices health for exceptional mobility.
trait.jjkcraft.six_eyes.desc: A Gojo-clan gift, separate from Limitless. Cursed technique costs are reduced and energy perception is sharper.
trait.jjkcraft.soul_awareness.desc: A resilient sense of self improves cursed-energy circulation and bodily durability.
trait.jjkcraft.spring_tendons.desc: Zero CE. Explosive movement and striking force come with lower durability.
trait.jjkcraft.vengeful_spirit.desc: A cursed body with more CE and health. CE regenerates injuries; exorcism creates a new character.
vow.jjkcraft.bare_skin.desc: Wear no armor. Putting any on breaks the vow. Dismantle cuts deeper under it.
vow.jjkcraft.closed_heart.desc: Never expand a domain. Domains are refused while it holds.
vow.jjkcraft.grounded_oath.desc: Never jump. Jumping breaks the vow. The Ink-Iron Palm hits much harder under it.
vow.jjkcraft.half_vessel.desc: Hold only half your usual cursed energy.
vow.jjkcraft.measured_pace.desc: Never sprint. Sprinting breaks the vow.
vow.jjkcraft.night_covenant.desc: Cast techniques only in darkness: at night or out of the sky's reach. Grudge Bolt is cheaper and longer under it.
vow.jjkcraft.open_guard.desc: Never raise a shield. Blocking breaks the vow.
vow.jjkcraft.single_path.desc: Cast only your innate technique. Others are refused while it holds.
technique.jjkcraft.harmony_step.desc: A short, safe spatial step. Express it as a forward, backward, sideways or vertical movement.
technique.jjkcraft.chaos_twist.desc: Disrupt nearby opponents with a spatial repulsion. Tune its reach, force, impact lift and commitment.
technique.jjkcraft.harmony_field.desc: Shape a sustained attracting field. Personalize its center, pulse rhythm, force and edge falloff.
technique.jjkcraft.chaos_fracture.desc: A narrow spatial fracture along your aim. Customize its width, reach, output and piercing.
technique.jjkcraft.light_ray.desc: Fire a bright, fast bolt. Create your own gravity, size, volley pattern and guidance.
technique.jjkcraft.darkness_field.desc: Gather opponents in a dark pressure field. Choose placement, timing, output and target class.
technique.jjkcraft.twin_radiance.desc: Release a spread of luminous projectiles. Change its pattern, count, gravity and steering.
technique.jjkcraft.darkness_nova.desc: Release a close-range pressure wave. Shape its area, output, impact lift and recoil.
cast_failure.jjkcraft.not_enough_health: Not enough health for this expression

curse.jjkcraft.paper_tick.lore: Fear of discarded letters collects in neglected corners. A single one is weak; a nest of them is dangerous.

technique.jjkcraft.charge_transfer.desc: Mark the aimed enemy with electrical charge. Up to three charges prime your discharge. Gameplay adaptation.
technique.jjkcraft.lightning_discharge.d: Consume the aimed enemy's stored charges for an electrical strike. Requires your own mark and line of sight.
technique.jjkcraft.return_stroke.desc: Consume charges on all your marked nearby enemies, chaining lightning through the group.
technique.jjkcraft.granite_blast.desc: Project a broad burst of concentrated cursed energy. Heavy output, adjustable reach and blast size. Gameplay adaptation.

technique.jjkcraft.thorn_snare.desc: Bind visible enemies briefly at the aimed point; existing marks extend the short bind. Poisoned thorns punish proximity; a paid guard reflects a bounded fraction of damage.

technique.jjkcraft.mini_blue.desc: A fast, inexpensive attraction point. Short-lived and precise; adjust reach, area and force independently.
technique.jjkcraft.blue_punch.desc: Toggle Blue imbuement on your fists. A landed unarmed punch pulls its target toward you and deals bonus Limitless damage for 5 CE. Cast again to clear it. Works alongside CE fist imbuement.
technique.jjkcraft.blue_cluster.desc: Place three small attraction points across your aimed plane. Terrain clips each point; smaller fields trade reach for cross-pressure.
technique.jjkcraft.mini_red.desc: An inexpensive, immediate repulsion field. Short knockback burst with a small footprint; useful for disengaging.
technique.jjkcraft.red_punch.desc: Toggle Red imbuement on your fists. A landed unarmed punch repels its target and deals bonus Limitless damage for 7 CE. Cast again to clear it. Works alongside CE fist imbuement.
technique.jjkcraft.maximum_output_red.de: Build a slow maximum-output charge, then launch a large repulsion field outward. Full charge reaches an eleven-block influence radius.
screen.jjkcraft.family_selector.desc: A family selector: activate to open the wheel of learned applications. Hold a variant to charge where supported, or bind one move directly.
technique.jjkcraft.positive_energy_disch: Project positive energy through a short, aimed line. Damages cursed spirits, including spirit players, and passes harmlessly through living humans. Requires learned RCT.
cast_failure.jjkcraft.untamed: Untamed shikigami · defeat it in the Ten Shadows subjugation ritual first
item.jjkcraft.black_rope.desc: Its cursed fibers disrupt active techniques and drain 9 CE on a landed strike.
item.jjkcraft.executioners_blade.desc: An original ritual blade that lends Cleave while held. It has no instant-kill effect.
item.jjkcraft.soulsteel_katana.desc: An original forged katana. Landed strikes siphon 3 CE; while held, it lends Grudge Bolt.
item.jjkcraft.ritual_armor.desc: Each worn piece wards 4% of technique damage for 1.5 CE per damage prevented (16% with the full set). Ordinary armour remains when CE runs out.
item.jjkcraft.sealed_reliquary.desc: Sneak and use to break the seal: restore 250 CE, but suffer Weakness for 15 seconds. Consumed on use; 10-second cooldown.
item.jjkcraft.sealed_reliquary.confirm: Sneak and use to break the seal. Restores 250 CE, but inflicts Weakness for 15 seconds.
item.jjkcraft.warding_talisman.desc: Use: spend 25 CE for four absorption health for 60 seconds. Consumed on use; 10-second cooldown.
tooltip.jjkcraft.tool.activate: Use while holding this tool to cast its technique.
trait.jjkcraft.cursed_vessel.desc: An exceptionally strong body: +2.5 attack damage, +6 health, +8% movement speed and 140 stamina. Sukuna relics grant power but weaken your control. Rest and maintain health and CE to suppress him.
